abstract: The 2021–2022 energy crisis generated pronounced episodes of explosive price behavior followed by sharp corrections in gas and electricity markets and raised concerns about whether observed price surges reflected fundamental scarcity or speculative dynamics. This paper examines the presence and synchronization of explosive price behavior across a comprehensive set of European and U.S. gas and electricity benchmarks, as well as carbon-neutral hydrogen and renewable Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) price series. We apply the multiple-bubble testing framework of Phillips, Shi and Yu (2015) and its panel extension to detect and date-stamp common episodes of explosivity across fossil-fuel and transition-related markets. Our results reveal synchronized explosive dynamics during the crisis period, with evidence that exuberance was not confined to traditional energy markets but also extended to hydrogen and renewable PPA benchmarks. For gas and electricity markets, where futures data are available, spot-forward diagnostics provide additional evidence on the interpretation of explosive episodes. Overall, the findings offer new insights into the propagation of instability across fossil and green energy price benchmarks and contribute to the debate on energy market dynamics during periods of systemic stress.
abstract_zh: 2021—2022年能源危机在天然气和电力市场引发了显著的价格爆炸性行为，随后又出现急剧回调，并引发了人们对所观察到的价格飙升究竟反映基本面稀缺还是投机动态的担忧。本文考察了欧洲和美国一系列广泛的天然气与电力基准，以及碳中和氢和可再生能源购电协议（PPA）价格序列中爆炸性价格行为的存在及其同步性。我们采用Phillips、Shi和Yu（2015）的多重泡沫检验框架及其面板扩展，以识别并标注化石燃料和转型相关市场中共同的爆炸性阶段。我们的结果揭示了危机期间同步出现的爆炸性动态，并有证据表明，这种过热并不限于传统能源市场，还扩展到了氢和可再生能源PPA基准。对于可获得期货数据的天然气和电力市场，即期—远期诊断为进一步解释爆炸性阶段提供了额外证据。总体而言，这些发现为不稳定在化石能源和绿色能源价格基准之间的传播提供了新的见解，并有助于关于系统性压力时期能源市场动态的讨论。
title: Energy market bubbles under the green transition
title_zh: 绿色转型下的能源市场泡沫

abstract: This paper studies the effects of moral hazard on employment and wage dynamics in a continuous-time competitive search model. Unobservable idiosyncratic factors require employers to design dynamic contracts to incentivize workers to exert effort. A higher level of public aggregate productivity reduces the relative importance of unobservable idiosyncratic factors, which facilitates the detection of shirking and relaxes firms’ incentive constraint. This channel amplifies the elasticity of vacancy to changes in aggregate productivity and induces time-varying schemes in wage compensation. When the informational friction is disciplined by the moment on individual workers’ wage residuals in PSID, the model produces higher unemployment volatility than that without the moral hazard problem. In addition, the model generates endogenous counter-cyclical wage dispersion.
abstract_zh: 本文研究道德风险对连续时间竞争性搜寻模型中就业与工资动态的影响。不可观测的异质性因素要求雇主设计动态合同以激励工人付出努力。较高的公共总量生产率水平降低了不可观测异质性因素的相对重要性，这有助于识别偷懒行为并放松企业的激励约束。该渠道放大了空缺对总量生产率变化的弹性，并引致工资补偿中的时变机制。当信息摩擦由PSID中个体工人工资残差的矩进行约束时，该模型产生的失业波动高于不存在道德风险问题时的情形。此外，该模型生成了内生的逆周期工资离散。
title: Competitive Search with Repeated Moral Hazard
title_zh: 重复道德风险下的竞争性搜索

abstract: We propose a threshold heterogeneous autoregressive model for interval-valued time series (THARI). Building on the heterogeneous autoregressive (HAR) framework, THARI combines threshold interval autoregression with daily, weekly, and monthly aggregation, allowing multi-horizon interval dynamics to vary across regimes. Estimation uses minimum- D K distance with a feasible positive-definite kernel update. For fixed and feasible kernels, the threshold estimator is T -consistent and the regression estimator is T -consistent. For Ethereum intervals constructed from the 50th and 95th quantiles of 5-minute intraday squared returns, THARI improves D K 2 forecasts over TARI(3), while comparison with a non-threshold interval HAR benchmark identifies horizon-dependent threshold gains.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种用于区间值时间序列的阈值异质自回归模型（THARI）。该模型建立在异质自回归（HAR）框架之上，将阈值区间自回归与日度、周度和月度聚合相结合，使多期限区间动态能够随不同机制而变化。估计采用最小 \(D_K\) 距离，并配合可行的正定核更新。对于固定且可行的核，阈值估计量具有 \(T\) 一致性，回归估计量也具有 \(T\) 一致性。对于由5分钟日内平方收益的第50和第95分位数构建的以太坊区间，THARI 相较于 TARI(3) 改善了 \(D_K^2\) 预测，而与一个非阈值区间 HAR 基准的比较则识别出依赖于期限的阈值增益。
title: Threshold HAR model for interval-valued time series
title_zh: 区间值时间序列的阈值HAR模型

abstract: We study the structure and heterogeneity of discriminatory behavior using an incentivized choice experiment with a representative sample of over 2000 adults in Germany. Decision-makers allocate a fixed endowment between two receivers whose migration background, education, gender, and age are randomly varied. This design allows us to compare discrimination across attributes within an integrative framework, analyze how these dimensions interact, and classify individuals into behavioral types. We show pronounced discrimination against Turkish migrants in allocation choices, comparable in magnitude to gender-based preferential treatment in favor of women. Discrimination against Turkish migrants varies systematically with other receiver attributes and across decision makers, and is particularly strong among non-migrants and individuals with right-wing political preferences.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项激励性选择实验，研究了歧视行为的结构与异质性，实验对象为德国2000多名成年人的代表性样本。决策者在两个接受者之间分配一笔固定禀赋，而接受者的移民背景、教育程度、性别和年龄均被随机变化。这一设计使我们能够在一个整合框架内比较不同属性之间的歧视，分析这些维度如何相互作用，并将个体划分为不同行为类型。我们发现，在分配选择中存在对土耳其移民的显著歧视，其程度与基于性别而对女性的偏好性待遇相当。对土耳其移民的歧视随其他接受者属性以及不同决策者而系统性变化，并且在非移民以及具有右翼政治偏好的个体中尤为强烈。
title: The structure of discrimination against Turkish migrants in Germany
title_zh: 德国对土耳其移民歧视的结构

abstract: Water suppliers are showing greater interest in using residential water audits to promote conservation. Yet there is limited causal evidence on their effectiveness, persistence, and welfare implications. We address this gap using a natural field experiment in the United Kingdom that randomly assigns about 45,000 households to receive different behavioural encouragements to complete an online home water audit. Our analysis yields three main findings. First, financial incentives substantially increase audit take-up and lead to large short-run reductions in water use: among compliers, consumption falls by about 17 per cent over a two-month period. The size of the incentive matters for participation but not for the magnitude of conservation. Second, conservation effects attenuate rapidly, becoming undetectable after roughly two months. As a result, the intervention yields small welfare gains, with per capita net benefits typically below Â£1 under a wide range of assumptions. Third, targeting high-use households roughly doubles short-run conservation effects but remains insufficient to generate sizable welfare gains because conservation does not persist. Overall, while audits and incentives induce meaningful short-run conservation, their policy value depends critically on whether these effects persist.
abstract_zh: 供水供应商对利用居民用水审计促进节水表现出越来越大的兴趣。然而，关于其有效性、持续性和福利影响的因果证据仍然有限。我们利用英国的一项自然实地实验来填补这一空白，该实验将约45,000户家庭随机分配到不同的行为激励条件下，以鼓励其完成在线家庭用水审计。我们的分析得出三个主要发现。第一，经济激励大幅提高了审计参与率，并导致用水量在短期内大幅下降：在依从者中，两个月内用水量下降约17%。激励力度的大小影响参与率，但不影响节水的幅度。第二，节水效应迅速衰减，约两个月后便无法检测到。因此，该干预带来的福利收益较小，在多种假设下，人均净收益通常低于1英镑。第三，以高用水家庭为目标大致可使短期节水效应翻倍，但仍不足以产生可观的福利收益，因为节水效果无法持续。总体而言，尽管审计和激励能够带来有意义的短期节水，但其政策价值关键取决于这些效应能否持续。
title: Do Water Audits Work?
title_zh: 水审计有效吗？

abstract: Research finds complete tariff pass-through at the product level during the 2018-2019 US-China trade war. Using firm-level customs data, we find a significant decrease in Chinese firms’ ex-tariff prices in response to US tariffs, which indicates incomplete pass-through. A one-percentage-point tariff increase reduces prices by 0.172 percentage points for the highest-priced 25% of exporters while having negligible effects on firms with below-median prices. US tariffs increase Chinese exporters’ probability of exiting the US market, with larger effects for lower-priced firms. The product-level complete pass-through results from two offsetting forces—price reduction by incumbents and market exits by lower-priced firms.
abstract_zh: 研究发现，在2018—2019年中美贸易战期间，产品层面存在完全的关税传递。利用企业层面海关数据，我们发现中国企业对美关税的回应是关税外价格显著下降，这表明存在不完全传递。关税每提高1个百分点，价格最高的25%出口商的价格下降0.172个百分点，而对价格低于中位数的企业影响可忽略不计。美国关税提高了中国出口商退出美国市场的概率，且对价格较低企业的影响更大。产品层面的完全传递源于两种相互抵消的力量——在位企业的降价和价格较低企业的市场退出。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Reconciling Aggregate And Firm-Level Tariff Pass-Through: Evidence From The 2018–2019 Us Tariffs On China
title_zh: 调和总体与公司层面的关税转嫁：来自2018-2019年美国对华关税的证据

abstract: School assignment policies are a key lever for expanding access to high-performing schools and promoting racial and socioeconomic integration. For over 50 years, the Metropolitan Council for Educational Opportunity (METCO) has bussed students of color from Boston, Massachusetts to relatively wealthier and predominantly White suburbs. I estimate the effects of attending a high-performing suburban school by comparing applicants who receive enrollment offers with applicants who do not. A two-stage least squares approach exploits waitlist assignment priorities and controls for a rich set of characteristics from birth records and application data. Attending a suburban school boosts math and English test scores, reduces dropout, and increases on-time high school graduation. Four-year college aspirations, enrollment, and graduation increase along with earnings in adulthood. Students whose parents did not attend college and boys experience the largest effects. The evidence points to several mechanisms, including access to higher value-added schools, higher achieving peers, and schools with stronger college-going norms. Participants are more likely to be tracked into lower performing classes, implying that effects could be larger with access to more advanced coursework. District value-added estimates suggest that students’ educational trajectories shift at least as much as they would from growing up in the suburban districts.
abstract_zh: 学校分配政策是扩大优质学校入学机会、促进种族和社会经济融合的关键杠杆。50多年来，城市教育机会大都会委员会（METCO）一直用校车将马萨诸塞州波士顿的有色人种学生送往相对更富裕且以白人为主的郊区。我通过比较收到入学录取的申请者与未收到录取的申请者，估计了就读高绩效郊区学校的影响。两阶段最小二乘法利用候补名单分配优先级，并控制了来自出生记录和申请数据的一系列丰富特征。就读郊区学校会提高数学和英语考试成绩，降低辍学率，并提高按时高中毕业率。四年制大学志向、入学率和毕业率上升，成年后的收入也随之增加。父母未上过大学的学生以及男孩受到的影响最大。证据指向若干机制，包括能够进入增值更高的学校、接触成绩更高的同伴，以及进入具有更强大学升学规范的学校。参与者更有可能被分轨到表现较低的班级，这意味着如果能够接触更高级别的课程，影响可能会更大。学区增值估计表明，学生的教育轨迹至少会像在郊区学区成长那样发生同等程度的变化。
title: Busing to Opportunity? The Impacts of the METCO Voluntary School Desegregation Program on Urban Students of Color
title_zh: 乘车前往机遇？METCO自愿学校废除种族隔离项目对城市有色人种学生的影响

abstract: This paper studies the estimation of a linear panel data model with interactive fixed effects. A transformation is introduced which, after having been applied, renders the least squares (LS) estimator of Bai (2009) consistent and asymptotically unbiased when n is large and T is fixed. This is termed the transformed least squares (TLS) estimator. Going further, these properties are shown to also carry over to the large n, large T setting, provided T/n → 0. This contrasts sharply with the usual case, where the LS estimator is, in general, inconsistent when n is large and T is fixed, and is asymptotically biased when both n and T are large.
abstract_zh: 本文研究具有交互固定效应的线性面板数据模型的估计问题。本文引入一种变换，在应用该变换之后，当n较大且T固定时，Bai（2009）的最小二乘（LS）估计量具有一致性和渐近无偏性。这被称为变换最小二乘（TLS）估计量。进一步地，本文表明，只要T/n → 0，这些性质在n较大、T较大的情形下也同样成立。这与通常情形形成鲜明对比：在通常情形下，当n较大且T固定时，LS估计量一般是不一致的，而当n和T都较大时，则具有渐近偏误。
title: Panel data models with interactive fixed effects and (relatively) small T
title_zh: 具有交互固定效应和（相对）小T的面板数据模型

abstract: The effective use of carbon pricing instruments to promote a sustainable energy transition has become a central issue in international climate negotiations. Using energy concentration as a proxy indicator, this paper evaluates the effects of the carbon emissions trading system (ETS) and carbon tax (CTax) on the sustainable energy transition drawing on global data on energy consumption and the energy industry. The results indicate that the ETS directly and significantly reduces energy concentration, whereas the CTax shows no direct effect. Specifically, the ETS has led to a significant increase in the consumption share and number of generating units based on clean fossil and renewable energy sources. In contrast, in countries implementing a CTax, although the renewable energy industry has expanded, there has been no significant increase in renewable energy consumption, nor a notable reduction in the scale of coal mining or the coal-based steel industry. A portfolio of carbon pricing instruments currently fails to generate effective linkage effects. Given the expansion of energy consumption and increasing uncertainty, the ETS is better suited to a sustainable energy transition. Therefore, developing countries should actively participate in the design of ETS mechanisms to ensure a sustainable energy transition.
abstract_zh: 有效运用碳定价工具促进可持续能源转型，已成为国际气候谈判的核心议题。本文以能源集中度作为代理指标，基于全球能源消费与能源产业数据，评估碳排放交易体系（ETS）与碳税（CTax）对可持续能源转型的影响。结果表明，ETS直接且显著降低能源集中度，而CTax未表现出直接效应。具体而言，ETS促使基于清洁化石能源和可再生能源的发电单元在消费份额与数量上显著增加。相比之下，在实施CTax的国家，尽管可再生能源产业有所扩张，但可再生能源消费未显著增长，煤炭开采或煤基钢铁产业规模也未明显缩减。当前碳定价工具组合未能产生有效的联动效应。鉴于能源消费扩张与不确定性增加，ETS更适合可持续能源转型。因此，发展中国家应积极参与ETS机制设计，以确保可持续能源转型。
title: Carbon pricing instruments and the sustainable energy transition: evidence on energy concentration and the energy industry
title_zh: 碳定价工具与可持续能源转型：关于能源集中度和能源产业的证据

abstract: Coordination failure is an obstacle to collective efficiency in many economic and social settings. Leadership can attenuate this problem by providing a focal point through public communication. Yet, the effectiveness of such communication relies on shared trust that the leader’s recommendations will be followed by others. As generative artificial intelligence (AI) becomes increasingly accessible, leaders may use AI-generated texts in their public communications. Whether transparent AI assistance weakens the coordinating role of leadership remains an open question. We investigate this issue through an online experiment based on the minimum effort game with leadership. Leaders could send either a human-written or a ChatGPT-generated message, and followers were informed of the message’s source. Results reveal that coordination outcomes do not differ across treatments: AI-generated and human-written messages are equally effective in promoting coordination on the Pareto-dominant equilibrium. In addition, both leaders’ and followers’ beliefs about other players’ behavior are unaffected by the source of the message. These findings suggest a leader’s transparent choice to communicate through AI-generated messages does not undermine strategic communication or followers’ trust in successful coordination.
abstract_zh: 协调失败是许多经济和社会情境中实现集体效率的障碍。领导力可以通过公共沟通提供聚焦点来缓解这一问题。然而，这种沟通的有效性依赖于一种共同信任，即相信其他人会遵循领导者的建议。随着生成式人工智能（AI）日益普及，领导者可能在其公共沟通中使用AI生成的文本。透明地借助AI是否削弱了领导力的协调作用，仍是一个未决问题。我们通过一项基于带领导力的最小努力博弈的在线实验来研究这一问题。领导者可以发送人类撰写的消息或ChatGPT生成的消息，且追随者会被告知消息的来源。结果表明，不同处理下的协调结果没有差异：AI生成的消息和人类撰写的消息在促进协调至帕累托占优均衡方面同样有效。此外，领导者和追随者关于其他参与者行为的信念均不受消息来源的影响。这些发现表明，领导者透明地选择通过AI生成的消息进行沟通，并不会削弱策略性沟通或追随者对成功协调的信任。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 251
title: Coordination and leadership: The impact of artificial intelligence
title_zh: 协调与领导：人工智能的影响

abstract: Environmental land registries are increasingly used to support forest governance, yet their potential contribution to reducing rural land conflict remains poorly understood. Brazil’s Cadastro Ambiental Rural (CAR) requires landholders to self-declare property boundaries and land use for environmental compliance but neither confers legal title nor resolves competing land claims. Before becoming mandatory under Brazil’s 2012 Forest Code, the CAR was piloted in the Amazonian state of Pará beginning in 2008. We exploit this early implementation to examine whether an environmental land registry can reduce rural violence in frontier regions characterized by weak property rights and limited state capacity. Using municipality-level panel data (2001–2012) and a synthetic difference-in-differences design, we estimate that early CAR implementation reduced land conflict events by 11.5%, families affected by conflict by 33.4%, and land-related death threats by 10.0%. Murders and attempted murders are too rare for the design to detect effects of plausible magnitude. The estimated reductions are not uniform across outcomes or institutional environments. Death threats decline consistently across all estimation samples, whereas reductions in conflict events and families affected are concentrated in municipalities with complementary governance programs and stronger pre-treatment enforcement capacity. These findings are consistent with environmental registration operating through complementary informational and institutional channels. Documenting land occupation appears sufficient to discourage lower-intensity forms of conflict, while larger reductions in realized conflict require institutions capable of acting on the information the registry provides. More broadly, the results suggest that information-based land administration can improve land governance before formal property rights are resolved.
abstract_zh: 环境土地登记日益被用于支持森林治理，但其在减少农村土地冲突方面的潜在贡献仍鲜为人知。巴西的农村环境登记系统（Cadastro Ambiental Rural, CAR）要求土地所有者自行申报财产边界和土地利用情况以满足环境合规要求，但既不授予合法产权，也不解决相互竞争的土地主张。在2012年《巴西森林法典》将其设为强制要求之前，CAR自2008年起在亚马孙地区的帕拉州进行了试点。我们利用这一早期实施来考察环境土地登记能否减少以产权薄弱和国家能力有限为特征的边疆地区的农村暴力。使用市级面板数据（2001—2012年）和合成双重差分设计，我们估计早期CAR实施使土地冲突事件减少了11.5%，受冲突影响的家庭减少了33.4%，与土地相关的死亡威胁减少了10.0%。谋杀和谋杀未遂过于罕见，该设计无法检测出合理量级的效应。估计的减少在不同结果或制度环境下并不一致。死亡威胁在所有估计样本中均持续下降，而冲突事件和受影响家庭的减少则集中在具有配套治理项目和更强预处理执法能力的市镇。这些发现与环境登记通过互补的信息和制度渠道发挥作用相一致。记录土地占用似乎足以遏制较低强度的冲突形式，而要实现已发生冲突的更大幅度减少，则需要有能力对登记系统所提供信息采取行动的机构。更广泛地说，结果表明，基于信息的土地管理可以在正式产权得到解决之前改善土地治理。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
title: Land registration and conflict reduction: Evidence from the Brazilian Amazon
title_zh: 土地登记与冲突减少：来自巴西亚马逊地区的证据

abstract: We study the propensity of independent algorithms to collude in repeated asymmetric Cournot duopolies, specifically the predictive power of various oligopoly and bargaining solutions with respect to the effect of asymmetry among firms. We find that total quantities are below the static Nash level in all specifications, and they increase with asymmetry. Thus, both consumers and firms can benefit from asymmetry. For low (high) levels of asymmetry, the simulated quantities are above (below) the joint profit-maximizing output. While the static Nash equilibrium provides accurate predictions regarding total welfare, bargaining solutions, such as equal relative gains, better capture our finding of convergence to Pareto-efficient outcomes.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了独立算法在重复非对称古诺双寡头中合谋的倾向，特别是各种寡头与讨价还价解在预测企业间非对称性影响方面的能力。我们发现，在所有设定中，总产量均低于静态纳什水平，并且随着非对称性增加而上升。因此，消费者和企业都能从非对称性中受益。对于低（高）程度的非对称性，模拟产量高于（低于）联合利润最大化产出。虽然静态纳什均衡能准确预测总福利，但讨价还价解，如相等相对收益，更能解释我们所发现的向帕累托有效结果收敛的现象。
title: The spoils of algorithmic collusion: Profit allocation among asymmetric firms
title_zh: 算法合谋的收益：不对称企业间的利润分配

abstract: How socially distinct are competing political parties' candidate pools? Since names encode cultural milieu, lineage, linguistic origin, and ancestry that standard socioeconomic variables miss, we measure social sorting across parties with names, predicting affiliation out of sample within municipality-years. Across more than 2.5 million local-election candidates, names pick the right-wing candidate in a random within-municipality pair 55.8% of the time in Spain and 56.5% in France. Given names alone do most of the work: around 55.0%. Under a stylized model of intergenerational transmission of political orientation, this translates to an implied gap of about 25 p.p. in parental naming propensities. The signal is stable in Spain but doubles in France by 2026. Within ideological families, names separate parties as sharply as across the right--left divide, even more so in France. The Spanish cleavage is linguistic and growing. The French one runs through names of immigrant origin and is strongest in large cities.
abstract_zh: 相互竞争的政治党派候选人群体在社会层面有多大差异？由于姓名编码了标准社会经济变量所遗漏的文化环境、血统、语言来源和祖先信息，我们用姓名来衡量政党间的社会分选，并在市镇-年份内进行样本外预测党派归属。在超过250万名地方选举候选人中，姓名在西班牙能以55.8%的概率、在法国能以56.5%的概率，从同一市镇内的随机配对中选出右翼候选人。仅凭名字就发挥了主要作用：约为55.0%。在一个关于政治取向代际传递的简化模型下，这意味着父母命名倾向的隐含差距约为25个百分点。该信号在西班牙保持稳定，但在法国到2026年将翻倍。在意识形态家族内部，姓名区分政党的程度与左右分野一样明显，在法国甚至更强。西班牙的分野是语言性的，并且正在扩大。法国的分野则贯穿于移民来源姓名之中，且在大城市最为强烈。
title: Social Sorting and Political Cleavages: Evidence from 2.5 Million Electoral Candidates
title_zh: 社会分类与政治分歧：来自250万选举候选人的证据

abstract: This paper focuses on actively managed bond mutual funds, whose performance is most sensitive to monetary policy shocks. We document significant and persistent FOMC-day outperformance by macro-active bond funds, which is particularly pronounced during periods of heightened macroeconomic disagreement and attention. Consistent with their forecasting ability, these funds’ pre-FOMC portfolio duration adjustments can predict FOMC-day monetary policy shocks beyond the information offered by economic data and asset returns. Furthermore, we show that this macro-investing skill extends to GDP and CPI announcements and is consistently shared across various fund styles within fund families.
abstract_zh: 本文聚焦于主动管理的债券共同基金，其业绩对货币政策冲击最为敏感。我们记录了宏观主动型债券基金在联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）会议日具有显著且持续的超额表现，这种表现尤其在宏观经济分歧和关注度加剧的时期更为明显。与其预测能力相一致，这些基金在FOMC会议前的投资组合久期调整能够预测FOMC会议日的货币政策冲击，且这种预测能力超越了经济数据和资产收益所提供的信息。此外，我们表明这种宏观投资技能还延伸至GDP和CPI公告，并在基金家族内不同基金风格之间持续共享。
title: What can macro-active bond funds tell us about monetary policy change?
title_zh: 宏观主动型债券基金能告诉我们货币政策的哪些变化？

abstract: We use data from a survey of 116,061 households in India to study beliefs about inequality. We uncover large differences between where individuals believe their household stands on the income distribution and their actual position. However, informing individuals that their household is poorer than they thought has no discernible effect on support for reducing inequality. We posit that support for reducing inequality may be unresponsive to information because such information disregards the sharing of resources within religious or ethnic groups, in the form of religious and social goods. Households, especially those in the lower rungs of the distribution, benefit from these goods, which may shape their beliefs about inequality and their demand for redistribution. In districts with a greater supply of religious or social goods, we find that the average individual perceives their household as richer. Our findings suggest that group-specific public goods, found in many countries beyond India, deserve greater consideration in studies of inequality.
abstract_zh: 我们利用印度116,061户家庭的调查数据，研究人们对不平等的信念。我们发现，个体认为其家庭在收入分配中所处的位置与其实际位置之间存在巨大差异。然而，告知个体其家庭比他们想象的更贫穷，对其支持减少不平等的态度没有可察觉的影响。我们提出，对减少不平等的支持可能对信息不敏感，因为此类信息忽视了宗教或族群内部以宗教和社会物品形式进行的资源共享。家庭，尤其是处于分配较低阶层的家庭，从这些物品中受益，这可能塑造了他们对不平等的信念以及对再分配的需求。在宗教或社会物品供给更充足的地区，我们发现平均个体认为其家庭更富裕。我们的发现表明，在印度以外的许多国家中存在的群体特定公共物品，在不平等研究中值得更多关注。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization

raw_data.sciencedirect_search_journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization

source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 251
title: Perceptions of inequality and group-specific public goods
title_zh: 不平等感知与特定群体的公共物品

abstract: This paper explores the relationship between facial attractiveness and risk-taking preferences using three standard elicitation methods, each modeled on its own scale. Drawing on incentivized samples of students and professionals recruited directly from LinkedIn (plumbers, lawyers, and MBA-holding business professionals) along with a standard, continuous attractiveness measure, I find that beauty is associated with greater risk tolerance across generalized, financial, and social risk domains, most prominently among lawyers and MBAs. A validated proxy for confidence is consistent with partial mediation in the generalized and financial domains, with strength varying by occupation, while a direct association between attractiveness and risk tolerance persists throughout. Beauty is particularly correlated with cooperation in the socially risky Stag Hunt setting, a link that operates largely outside the confidence channel. These associations have implications for occupational selection, fair talent allocation, digital recruiting, and other managerial settings.
abstract_zh: 本文采用三种标准引出方法，每种方法均基于其各自的量表，探讨面部吸引力与风险承担偏好之间的关系。基于直接从领英招募的学生和专业人士（水管工、律师和拥有MBA学位的商业专业人士）的激励样本，并结合一种标准的连续吸引力测量方法，我发现美貌与在一般性、金融和社会风险领域更高的风险容忍度相关，这一关联在律师和MBA群体中最为突出。一个经过验证的信心代理变量与一般性和金融领域中的部分中介作用相一致，其强度因职业而异，而吸引力与风险容忍度之间的直接关联始终存在。美貌尤其与社会风险性的 stag hunt 情境中的合作相关，这一联系在很大程度上独立于信心渠道。这些关联对职业选择、公平的人才配置、数字招聘以及其他管理情境具有启示意义。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Bravado and Beguile: When the Beautiful Bet Boldly
title_zh: 虚张声势与诱惑：当美人豪赌时

abstract: This paper investigates the impact of financial frictions on sustainable economic growth in the global economy. We present a model of endogenous directed technical change including public and private financial sectors, allowing for an endogenous financing decision in terms of internal and different external financing of technical change. Capturing the dynamics between the ‘global North’ and the ‘global South’, we allow for technological development to occur through innovation or imitation and, hence, capturing technology diffusion in reduced form. Our findings substantiate the way in which the presence of financing costs and frictions in the financial markets—elevated for sustainable innovation and in the developing world—cause the global economy to converge towards a non-sustainable growth path in the absence of policy intervention. This development can be addressed partially by sustainable public investment. However, to steer the economy to a fully sustainable growth path, an additional incentivization of private investors may be required under high-friction scenarios.
abstract_zh: 本文考察金融摩擦对全球经济可持续增长的影响。我们构建了一个包含公共和私人金融部门的内生定向技术变迁模型，允许在技术变迁的内部融资与不同外部融资之间进行内生融资决策。通过刻画“全球北方”与“全球南方”之间的动态关系，我们允许技术发展通过创新或模仿发生，从而以简化形式捕捉技术扩散。我们的发现证实，在缺乏政策干预的情况下，金融市场中融资成本和摩擦的存在——对可持续创新以及发展中世界而言更为严重——会导致全球经济收敛于一条不可持续的增长路径。可持续公共投资可以部分应对这一发展态势。然而，在高摩擦情景下，要将经济引向完全可持续的增长路径，可能还需要对私人投资者提供额外激励。
title: Impacts of Public-Private International Sustainable Finance on Achieving Global Climate Goals Through Innovation and Technology Diffusion
title_zh: 公私国际可持续金融通过创新与技术扩散对实现全球气候目标的影响

abstract: Business environments dominated by information flows and autonomous tasks, typical of knowledge‐intensive industries, are likely to require enough social trust to be viable and productive. In this paper, we use new EUKLEMS & INTANProd industry‐level data covering a panel of 19 countries and 20 industries over the 1995–2018 period to investigate the influence of a key element of social capital – trust – on labor productivity in intangible‐intensive industries, controlling for hiring and firing regulations that can constrain the ability of managers to implement best practices productively. We find that in such industries, especially those intensive in organizational capital, productivity gains from high levels of trust are stronger than elsewhere, while too strict hiring and firing regulations are more damaging for productivity. Using a more limited sample for which data on management quality are available, we show that the positive impact of high trust on productivity in intangible‐intensive industries is channeled by the ability to benefit from good management, a key element of organizational capital. Productivity gains from relatively high levels of trust in knowledge‐rich environments are estimated to be sizable and our estimates survive instrumentation of potentially endogenous variables, inclusion of a wide range of controls, and several other robustness checks.
abstract_zh: 以信息流动和自主任务为主导的商业环境，典型存在于知识密集型产业中，这类环境很可能需要足够的社会信任才能维持运转并实现高效生产。本文利用涵盖1995—2018年期间19个国家、20个行业的EUKLEMS & INTANProd行业层面新数据，考察社会资本的一个关键要素——信任——对无形资本密集型产业劳动生产率的影响，并控制了可能制约管理者有效实施最佳实践的雇佣与解雇规制。我们发现，在此类产业中，尤其是组织资本密集型产业，高信任水平带来的生产率增益强于其他领域，而过于严格的雇佣与解雇规制对生产率的损害更大。利用一个可获得管理质量数据的较有限样本，我们表明，高信任对无形资本密集型产业生产率的正向影响，是通过从良好管理中获益的能力这一组织资本的关键要素来传导的。在知识丰富环境中，相对较高信任水平所带来的生产率增益估计相当可观，且我们的估计在经过潜在内生变量的工具变量处理、纳入广泛控制变量以及若干其他稳健性检验后依然成立。
title: Trust, intangible assets, and productivity
title_zh: 信任、无形资产与生产率

abstract: Many entrepreneurs eventually transition back into the labor market. While existing research documents discrimination against former entrepreneurs in developed economies, the sources of this discrimination and the extent to which this evidence generalizes to developing-country contexts remain poorly understood. By sending fictitious resumes to employers in which we vary the presence of entrepreneurial experience and whether it occurred before or after paid employment experience in two resume correspondence studies, we investigate whether and why former entrepreneurs face hiring discrimination in the Chinese labor market. We find substantial discrimination against former entrepreneurs. Guided by an employer decision model, we show that statistical discrimination is the primary source of this penalty, while finding no clear evidence regarding the presence of taste-based discrimination. A complementary survey-based choice experiment further indicates that employers’ concerns about former entrepreneurs’ commitment and fit can largely explain this discrimination. These results underscore that mitigating hiring discrimination for former entrepreneurs in emerging economies may require a combination of employee-side strategies, such as strategically acquiring paid employment experience, and employer-side interventions that reduce information asymmetries.
abstract_zh: 许多创业者最终会重新进入劳动力市场。尽管已有研究记录了发达经济体中针对前创业者的歧视，但这种歧视的来源以及该证据在多大程度上可推广至发展中国家情境，仍鲜有充分理解。通过在两份简历对应研究中向雇主发送虚构简历，并操纵其中是否存在创业经历以及该经历是发生在带薪就业经历之前还是之后，我们考察中国劳动力市场中前创业者是否以及为何面临招聘歧视。我们发现，前创业者遭受了显著歧视。在雇主决策模型的指导下，我们表明统计性歧视是这一惩罚的主要来源，而未发现明确证据表明存在基于偏好的歧视。一项 complementary 基于调查的选择实验进一步表明，雇主对前创业者承诺度和匹配度的担忧可以在很大程度上解释这种歧视。这些结果凸显出，在新兴经济体中减少针对前创业者的招聘歧视，可能需要结合员工侧策略，例如战略性地获取带薪就业经历，以及旨在减少信息不对称的雇主侧干预措施。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要明确以中国劳动力市场为研究对象，通过简历投递实验考察前创业者面临的招聘歧视，中国是核心研究背景。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: How does entrepreneurial experience affect future employment? Evidence from two correspondence studies
title_zh: 创业经历如何影响未来就业？来自两项对应研究的证据

abstract: We study future-blind preferences, which are preferences that heavily discount the future, within the space of infinite consumption streams. We give two definitions: N-blindness, where agents ignore periods beyond a fixed date N, and eventual blindness, where all but finitely many dates are neglected. Using a topological approach, we show that the finest topology ensuring eventual blindness coincides with the product topology. This provides a behavioral foundation for continuity in the product topology, which was considered for studying equilibrium existence in infinite-dimensional spaces. Finally, we characterize the dual spaces under these topologies.
abstract_zh: 我们研究未来盲偏好，即在无限消费流空间中，对未来给予高度贴现的偏好。我们给出两个定义：N-盲，即代理人忽略固定日期N之后的时期；以及最终盲，即除有限多个日期外，其余日期均被忽略。采用拓扑方法，我们证明，确保最终盲的最精细拓扑与乘积拓扑一致。这为乘积拓扑中的连续性提供了行为基础，而该连续性曾被用于研究无限维空间中的均衡存在性。最后，我们刻画了这些拓扑下的对偶空间。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Future-blindness and the product topology
title_zh: 未来盲视与乘积拓扑

abstract: With public debt at high peacetime levels, how advanced economies can reduce debt burdens is again at the centre of policy debate. This column examines the role of financial repression, perhaps the least studied channel, by applying new quantity-based measures to more than a century of data for 17 advanced economies. The findings show that repression has been a persistent feature of modern policymaking, playing an important role in post-World War II debt reduction and rising again since the Global Financial Crisis. With several of the conditions historically associated with repression present today, its use may increase going forward.
abstract_zh: 在公共债务处于和平时期高位的情况下，发达经济体如何减轻债务负担再次成为政策辩论的中心。本专栏通过将新的基于数量的测度方法应用于17个发达经济体一个多世纪的数据，考察了金融抑制这一或许研究最少的渠道的作用。研究结果表明，金融抑制一直是现代政策制定中的一个持续特征，在二战后债务削减中发挥了重要作用，并自全球金融危机以来再次上升。由于历史上与金融抑制相关的若干条件如今依然存在，其使用在未来可能增加。
authors: Marijn Bolhuis, Jakree Koosakul, Neil Shenai, Jie Yang
title: Quantifying financial repression through the lens of portfolio choice: A century of evidence
title_zh: 从投资组合选择视角量化金融抑制：一个世纪的证据

abstract: Every inflation index is an aggregation rule. This paper asks when the aggregation that measures the cost of living is also the one that should guide monetary stabilization. A Consumer Price Index (CPI) measures purchasing power; a stabilization index should weight sectoral prices by what they reveal about states in which the policy rate has high marginal welfare value. In standard New-Keynesian models, the two indices coincide. We show that they diverge when the sectors generating price movements differ from the sectors through which interest rates move demand, income, and marginal costs. New euro-area data reveal such a mismatch. Discretionary sectors are the cyclical quantity margin and employ many hand-to-mouth workers, while necessity sectors account for much of inflation variation. After a contractionary monetary policy shock, discretionary consumption and employment adjust the most, but necessity prices respond more. We lay out a two-sector New-Keynesian model with non-homothetic demand and sectoral labour market heterogeneity that is consistent with these findings. Even with symmetric shocks and homogeneous nominal rigidities, optimal simple rules place nearly all weight on discretionary inflation, because reacting to necessity inflation uses the discretionary sector as the adjustment margin for price movements in sectors with little quantity traction. With stickier discretionary prices, as observed in the euro area, a discretionary inflation rule improves welfare further and closes about two thirds of the welfare gap between a CPI inflation rule and Ramsey policy. Under the empirical distribution of euro-area shocks, the gains come from lower sectoral inflation volatility rather than lower aggregate real volatility. Expenditure weights need not be stabilization weights.
abstract_zh: 每个通胀指数都是一种加总规则。本文追问的是，衡量生活成本的加总规则何时同时也是应当指导货币稳定的加总规则。消费者价格指数（CPI）衡量购买力；而稳定指数应按各部门价格所揭示的、政策利率具有高边际福利价值的状态来对部门价格加权。在标准新凯恩斯模型中，这两个指数是一致的。我们表明，当产生价格变动的部门不同于利率借以影响需求、收入和边际成本的部门时，二者就会发生背离。新的欧元区数据揭示了这种错配。可自由支配部门是周期性数量边际，并雇用了大量月光族工人，而必需品部门则解释了通胀变动的很大一部分。在紧缩性货币政策冲击之后，可自由支配消费和就业调整幅度最大，但必需品价格反应更大。我们构建了一个包含非位似需求和部门劳动力市场异质性的两部门新凯恩斯模型，该模型与这些发现一致。即使在对称冲击和同质名义刚性下，最优简单规则也几乎将所有权重都放在可自由支配通胀上，因为对必需品通胀作出反应会把可自由支配部门当作价格变动的调整边际，而这些部门的价格变动几乎没有数量牵引力。在可自由支配价格更黏性的情况下——正如在欧元区所观察到的那样——可自由支配通胀规则会进一步改善福利，并弥合CPI通胀规则与拉姆齐政策之间约三分之二的福利差距。在欧元区冲击的经验分布下，收益来自更低的部门通胀波动性，而非更低的总体实际波动性。支出权重未必是稳定权重。
authors: Michele Andreolli & Natalie Rickard & Paolo Surico & Chiara Vergeat
title: Inflation composition and monetary stabilization
title_zh: 通货膨胀构成与货币稳定
